dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: One distinct, high-contrast white horizontal band across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, sharp-edged pale/white margins on folded secondary and tertial feathers against dark gray bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, distinct, high-contrast white oval patch on the posterior nape surrounded by black.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear transition boundary from the solid black crown to the greenish-yellow upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white cheek patch bordered by black on the crown and throat.
